Name: Crosstown
Overview: Crosstown is a retro-style, top-down action game. Up to four players navigate a randomly-generated maze, collecting "qreds", avoiding and fighting various monsters, and drilling through walls. Once a player collects four qreds, play advances to the next level. Between levels, a computer named "PIGGY" tells the players about the rules of the game, the history of Crosstown and the monsters therein, and the strange nature of the reality where the game takes place.
